jobs.meta: Systems Engineering · C++, HNSW, Ollama · 2025 – Present
jobs.lede: Engineered a custom C++ vector search engine with HNSW indexing and local Ollama RAG pipeline.
highlights: Built a Vector Database from scratch in **C++** implementing HNSW, KD-Tree, and Brute Force indexing for semantic search and retrieval.
Optimized nearest-neighbor search using **HNSW**, achieving up to **10x faster query execution** than brute-force search.
Developed a complete RAG pipeline using **Ollama** (`nomic-embed-text`, `llama3.2`), supporting **768-D embeddings**, REST APIs, and document retrieval.

jobs.lede: Designed a multithreaded Deep Packet Inspection engine capable of processing 1000+ packets/sec.
highlights: Developed a Deep Packet Inspection engine capable of processing **1000+ packets/sec** using multithreading.
Implemented packet parsing and **SNI-based domain detection** achieving accurate application-level protocol identification.
Built a filtering system supporting multiple rule types (**IP, domain, and application-level blocking**), reducing latency by **30%**.

jobs.meta: Full-Stack Platform · React, Spring Boot, MySQL · 2024 – 2025
jobs.lede: Built a full-stack alumni networking platform to solve fragmented communication between students and alumni.
highlights: Built a full-stack alumni networking platform using **React**, **Java (Spring Boot)**, **Bootstrap**, and **REST APIs**.
Developed role-based dashboards, alumni directory, job board, mentorship system, and advanced search/filtering for 3 user roles.
Reduced alumni lookup time by **40%**, improved data retrieval through REST API integration, and delivered a fully responsive application.
